# /test run semantics on data pack tests: retries and `requireAll`, optional tests, `runfailed` (with and without optional tests),
# the instance block's data after each outcome, `test stop`, a run started while another one is going, and re-running placed tests.
# Every test runs alone (see gametest_pack for why several environments or dimensions in one run are not compared).
#   scripts/command-diff.sh crates/mc-game/tests/fixtures/commands_corpus/gametest_run.txt
!datapack gametest/gtpack
!ignore passed! \(
!mask (\d+)ms
# the summary lines the bots receive are not compared (see gametest_pack); the console copy of every summary stays compared
!ignore ^Bot\| .*(Game Test complete! |All required tests passed|commands\.test\.summary)
!ignore ^Bot0?\| .*(Test structure missing Start block|Too many Start blocks)

# ---- the instance block after each outcome
test run gt:pass
!ticks 40 show
data get block 0 -60 0
test clearall
test run gt:fail
!ticks 40 show
data get block 0 -60 0
test clearall
test run gt:timeout
!ticks 40 show
data get block 0 -60 0
test clearall
test run gt:optional_fail
!ticks 40 show
data get block 0 -60 0
test clearall

# ---- retries: `numberOfTimes` and `requireAll`
test run gt:fail 3
!ticks 100 show
test clearall
test run gt:fail 3 true
!ticks 100 show
test clearall
test run gt:optional_fail 2
!ticks 100 show
test clearall
test run gt:flaky 2
!ticks 100 show
test clearall
test run gt:flaky 2 true
!ticks 100 show
test clearall
test run gt:timeout 2
!ticks 100 show
test clearall
test run gt:pass 2 true
!ticks 100 show
test clearall

# ---- runfailed: everything that failed since the last run (the failed list is forgotten by a new run), required tests only, repeated
test runfailed
test run gt:fail
!ticks 40 show
test runfailed
!ticks 40 show
test runfailed true
!ticks 40 show
test runfailed false 2
!ticks 100 show
test runfailed true 2 true
!ticks 100 show
test clearall
test run gt:optional_fail
!ticks 40 show
test runfailed
!ticks 40 show
test runfailed true
!ticks 40 show
test clearall
test run gt:pass
!ticks 40 show
test runfailed
test clearall

# ---- stop and restart
test run gt:timeout
test stop
!ticks 40 show
test locate gt:*
test clearall
test run gt:timeout
test run gt:pass
!ticks 40 show
test locate gt:*
test clearall

# ---- re-running placed tests
test run gt:fail
!ticks 40 show
test resetthese
!ticks 5 show
data get block 0 -60 0
test runthese
!ticks 40 show
test runthat
test runclosest
!ticks 40 show
test resetclosest
data get block 0 -60 0
test clearall
test runthese
test runclosest

# ---- permissions
@bot0 test run gt:pass
@bot0 test runfailed
@bot0 test stop
@bot test run gt:pass
!ticks 40 show
@bot test runfailed
!ticks 40 show
@bot test clearall
